name: Sovereign Military Order of Malta
description: A red field with a white cross extending to the edges.
history: The state flag of the Sovereign Military Order of Malta, a Catholic lay religious order founded in Jerusalem around 1099 that remains a sovereign subject of international law, with permanent observer status at the United Nations. The red field with white cross has marked the Order since the 13th century; its other flag, red with a white eight-pointed Maltese cross, is used by the Order's works.
